model_complexity_technique_sufficiency.preliminary_finding: Complexity is not the primary weakness; the defensible story is broad outcome-blind mechanism search followed by sample-aware parsimony.

event_universe_information_asymmetry.preliminary_finding: Earnings/EPS is proven strong on resolution, mapping, sampleability and PIT reproducibility; its relative information-asymmetry opportunity remains to be assessed ex ante against other event families.
